 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

This petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C is filed challenging the FIR in Crime No.0016/2023 registered by the Shahapur Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 506, 498A,
354, 149, 323 of IPC.
2. The respondent No.2 though served with notice has not chosen to appear through her counsel or in person.

3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State.
4.

The allegation in the FIR is that the informant is legally wedded wife of accused No.1, accused No.2 is the father-in-law, accused No.3 is the brother-in-law and accused Nos.4 and 5 are the sisters-in-law, and the accused subjected her to cruelty, both mentally and physically, and unable to bear the cruelty, she went to her parental home on 2.1.2023.

The accused came to the parental home of the informant, and abused her in filthy language, and when she resisted the said abusing language, they pushed her to the floor and threatened her with dire consequence.

5. On an earlier occasion, the informant had filed a complaint for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 149 of IPC making verbatim allegation as against the Dastagir S/O Nabisab Mundaragi And Ors vs State Of Karnataka And Anr on 22 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52989059/
2 petitioners - accused herein.

entities.text: Nabisab Mundaragi And Ors vs State Of Karnataka And Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Trial Court after examining the evidence on record acquitted the petitioners - accused herein of the aforesaid offences on the ground that the prosecution has failed to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt.

After the acquittal of the petitioners - accused herein, the informant lodged the second FIR which clearly implies that the dispute between the parties arises out of the marital discord, however given a criminal texture with an ulterior motive to wreak vengeance against the petitioners- accused and with revengeful intent.
Even otherwise, except omnibus and general allegation, there is no specific allegation as to how and when each of the accused subjected the informant to cruelty both mentally and physically.

Hence,
the continuation of investigation against the petitioners - accused herein will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Criminal petition is allowed.
ii) The impugned FIR in Crime No.16/2023 registered by the Shahapur Police Station, Yadigir, pending on the file of the Civil Judge and JMFC (Jr. Dn.), Shahapur,
is hereby quashed.

Sd/-
